material: Buddy Talks AUDIO FILE - The final -ed sounds
lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll fix the ending that gives away an accent when you talk about the past. It’s... …THE -ED ENDING! Three sounds hide behind these two letters: ACHIEVED

Getting -ed right is what separates fluent English from careful English. An extra syllable in every past verb makes fluent speech sound heavy.
